articles.title: Wynn Officially Unveils the Highly Acclaimed 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards in November
articles.summary: Macao, October 8, 2026 — “Wynn Signature” will unveil the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards calendar on November 9, 2026, with entries opening March 1, 2027. In a first for the awards, Beijing will host Judging Week from August 21 to 25, 2027, and the Awards Ceremony will be held in Macao on October 29, 2027.
